history.summary: Comparison listing surfaced by the condo search, not the evaluation target. 969 sqft 2BR at $1.63M ($1,682 psf) — the largest 2BR of the three sisters but also the oldest project (TOP 2011) with the shortest remaining lease (~81 years), 400m to Bedok Reservoir MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Mid-pack value: psf sits between Waterfront Gold and the Key target, and the larger 969 sqft floor plate suits families/own-stay, but the higher $1.63M quantum thins the buyer pool and the oldest building plus shortest lease of the trio work against a 5-7 year investment exit. URA cache appreciation 7.34%/yr is backward-looking like its sisters. Not researched in depth — Neutral with low confidence.
red_flags: Oldest of the three sisters (15 years) — renovation and maintenance risk highest here
Shortest remaining lease (~81 years) of the trio
Higher quantum for the same location reduces exit liquidity vs the cheaper sisters
catalysts: Same Bayshore/TEL halo and Bedok Reservoir micro-market scarcity as Waterfront Key
